issue_title: [Security] load() uses Path.stat() before Path.exists() check - potential TOCTOU race

fix_summary.problem: TOCTOU race condition in load() where file could be deleted between exists() check and stat() call
fix_summary.solution: Removed redundant exists() check and added FileNotFoundError handling for both stat() and read_text() calls

risks.description: Behavior change: FileNotFoundError now returns empty list instead of propagating
risks.mitigation: This is the expected behavior for a missing storage file; existing tests verify backward compatibility
